Counting it once gives 60 + 60 + 55 = 175 distinct EC. The prior-year regulations establish alternation for the Literature and Media / Medium and Orality seminar, but no corresponding Psycholinguistics rule. Article 7 does not resolve the duplicate, and Article 6 is a conditional route for mobility or the teaching minor. Prospective course tables cannot resolve the current ordinary-route requirement.
